primary_publication.title: Cube moves for s-embeddings and alpha-realizations

OWR PDFp27 / printed1785: Theorem4 and following maximal-three conjecture
target: For alpha>1, the proposed bound is at most three intersections of two construction curves sharing a focus, hence at most three possible new cube-move centers. In the realization version, six distinct boundary vertices and noncollinearity of both alternating triples are required; crossings are allowed. Proper embeddings require additional hypotheses and are a separate target.
submitted_claim: At alpha16, six fixed admissible boundary vertices, a directly certified incoming center, and at least five distinct outgoing centers. Neither exact maximum nor a proper-embedding counterexample is claimed.
